scope: Visual: each style in four directions, white and purple, with game-size figure. Automated head/ear/build coverage is recorded separately in test results.

styles.label: Bald
styles.notes: Intentional bare scalp; no artificial hair ink.

styles.label: Short
styles.notes: Retain swept locks, clean forehead opening and foreground ears.

styles.label: Buzzed
styles.notes: Remove stray long marks and broad shade bands; use translucent close-shaven coverage.

styles.label: Medium
styles.notes: Layered lock lines continue through both profiles and the nape.

styles.label: Long
styles.notes: Retain full lengths and part lines; soften the dark lower shading block.

styles.label: Bob
styles.notes: Keep the curved hem, internal strands and covered ear roots.

styles.label: Curly
styles.notes: Approved reference: retain the current curl and part line treatment.

styles.label: Wavy
styles.notes: Retain wave boundaries; soften the lower shadow mass.

styles.label: Bun
styles.notes: Keep gathered crown lines, bun contour and visible ears.

styles.label: Ponytail
styles.notes: Keep swept crown, hair tie and complete tail.

styles.label: Braids
styles.notes: Retain braid crossings and complete ends; ears stay in front.

styles.label: Locs
styles.notes: Retain solid lock boundaries; soften the darker lower lengths.

styles.label: Afro
styles.notes: Filter short disconnected texture fragments while retaining connected curl outlines.

styles.label: Mohawk
styles.notes: Keep deliberate bare sides, central ridge and rear strip.

styles.label: Shaved Side
styles.notes: Keep the intentionally shaved side and the swept opposite side.

styles.label: Thinning Top
styles.notes: Keep the thin side/rear ring; do not fill the intentionally bare crown.

styles.label: Pixie
styles.notes: Short layered lines remain fitted around the ears and nape.

styles.label: Side-swept pixie
styles.notes: Keep the asymmetric swept fringe and short rear cap.

styles.label: Textured crop
styles.notes: Retain short textured lock groups without adding speckle.

styles.label: Caesar
styles.notes: Keep straight fringe, curved crown lines and clean nape.

styles.label: Low fade
styles.notes: Apply the scalp fade to the rear as well as the temples; remove the opaque nape band.

styles.label: High-top fade
styles.notes: Retain the raised curl top; taper side/rear coverage into the selected skin.

styles.label: Flat-top
styles.notes: Keep the intentional level top and top-edge strokes; fade the rear cap.

styles.label: Quiff
styles.notes: Keep swept crown strokes; fade the rear rather than leaving a solid lower band.

styles.label: Pompadour
styles.notes: Preserve the rolled top; taper the sides and nape.

styles.label: Slicked back
styles.notes: Keep coherent swept-back strokes and full rear cap.

styles.label: Spiky
styles.notes: Keep separate spike contours and their root lines.

styles.label: Faux-hawk
styles.notes: Preserve the central ridge and soften side/rear fade coverage.

styles.label: Curly top fade
styles.notes: Retain curl outlines while tapering the temples and nape.

styles.label: Short twists
styles.notes: Keep connected twist boundaries in all four views.

styles.label: Bowl cut
styles.notes: Retain the rounded fringe, ear openings and complete rear cap.

styles.label: Curtain bangs
styles.notes: Keep the centre part and curved loose ends.

styles.label: Angled bob
styles.notes: Keep the angled profile hem and clean strand lines.

styles.label: Asymmetric bob
styles.notes: Keep the intended unequal sides; do not force the long fringe away from the eye.

styles.label: Braided bob
styles.notes: Keep the crown braid, gathered rear section and loose lower locks.

styles.label: Lob
styles.notes: Preserve shoulder-length ends and soften lower shading.

styles.label: Shag
styles.notes: Keep separate shag layers and a closed rear scalp.

styles.label: Wolf cut
styles.notes: Keep short crown layers and longer nape strands.

styles.label: Mullet
styles.notes: Keep short sides and complete long nape.

styles.label: Curly bob
styles.notes: Retain curved locks and the curly lower hem.

styles.label: Twist-out
styles.notes: Filter small texture fragments without losing the twist structure.

styles.label: Afro puff
styles.notes: Clean puff texture fragments; keep the smooth gathered scalp and tendrils.

styles.label: Twin puffs
styles.notes: Clean disconnected puff texture while retaining both puff silhouettes.

styles.label: Top knot
styles.notes: Keep the tied knot, swept high hairline and rear cap; exposed forehead is intentional.

styles.label: Half-up bun
styles.notes: Keep the top bun and complete loose lengths above clothing.

styles.label: High ponytail
styles.notes: Keep the high tie and complete long tail; preserve the swept fringe.

styles.label: Side ponytail
styles.notes: Keep the side tie and the asymmetric tail across all views.

styles.label: Space buns
styles.notes: Keep both tied buns and the fitted rear scalp.

styles.label: Bantu knots
styles.notes: Prune tiny fragments while keeping coherent knot spirals.

styles.label: Crown braid
styles.notes: Retain crown crossings and the gathered rear section.

styles.label: Low bun
styles.notes: Keep the lower knot and swept crown strands.

styles.label: Layered long
styles.notes: Retain complete layers and soften the darker lower lengths.

styles.label: Blunt long with bangs
styles.notes: Keep blunt fringe/end lines and reduce the harsh lower shadow block.

styles.label: Beach waves
styles.notes: Retain broad wave lines with lighter lower shading.

styles.label: Long curls
styles.notes: Preserve complete curl lines and soften their lower shadow mass.

styles.label: Twin braids
styles.notes: Keep both braid crossings, roots and ends.

styles.label: Box braids
styles.notes: Keep narrow braid lines, filter tiny fragments and soften lower shading.

styles.label: Long twists
styles.notes: Keep connected twist shapes and soften the lower shadow mass.

styles.label: Cornrows
styles.notes: Keep narrow continuous rows and intentional scalp channels; reject tiny disconnected ink fragments.

styles.label: Loose side braid
styles.notes: Keep the side braid, tied end and swept crown.

styles.label: Big afro
styles.notes: Keep the large round curl silhouette while filtering small disconnected texture marks.
